summary: PR #442 (eco-6hoxj.163.143, .163.140), proof scripts only. The wal-checkpoint-bound worker-alone check failed #439 on a slow runner (121.9 vs 117.9 MiB; main 48.7-81.1 MiB): the fixed byte limit measured runner speed. The check now requires at least 3 completed FULL passes and 3 real WAL rewinds (WAL-index salts) and bounds the peak by intake measured between completed passes, ending intake on a completed pass, with the hard bound off throughout. Five mutants fail it (never FULL, FULL never completes, PASSIVE only, stops after first pass, first FULL then stopped); 30/30 under per-core contention and 10/10 idle. The history writer handoff proof now prints per-slice phase timestamps on failure with the 250 ms bound kept. Lead review (independent of the Codex author): APPROVE; no runtime change.
